title: Keep note marker framing safe with invisible Unicode prefixes
outcome: Keep note marker framing safe with invisible Unicode prefixes
acceptance: Rendered note bodies beginning with Unicode whitespace, invisible/format or combining characters and U+2800 before a marker-like bracket cannot imitate the real note-session marker; the original prefix characters and raw JSON bodies remain preserved.
Regression tests cover U+2800 and combining-mark prefixes with real session markers present and absent, plus ordinary text and line/block indentation controls.

completion.summary: Note framing now escapes marker-shaped brackets after invisible and combining Unicode prefixes while preserving prefix characters and raw JSON. Exact regression tests, full Windows gate and independent acceptance pass.
